component.name: PineconeMC
component.summary: Minecraft launcher based on Prism Launcher
Лаунчер Minecraft на основе Prism Launcher

description.p: PineconeMC is a Minecraft launcher based on Prism Launcher with support for mods, modpacks, and Ely.by accounts.
PineconeMC — лаунчер Minecraft на основе Prism Launcher с поддержкой модов, модпаков и учётных записей Ely.by.
